info.title: Pexels Universal API
info.description: Search, browse, and retrieve Pexels stock photos, videos, and collections from the official Pexels API.

get.description: Retrieves a photo from Pexels by ID.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric Pexels photo ID.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

liked.description: Whether the authenticated user liked the photo.

src.description: Image source URLs in multiple sizes.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

get.description: Retrieves media from a Pexels collection.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Pexels collection ID.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Optional media filter: photos or videos.

schema.description: Optional media filter: photos or videos.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order of media in the collection: asc or desc. Defaults to asc.

schema.description: Order of media in the collection: asc or desc. Defaults to asc.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of records to skip before returning results.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

media.description: Photo and video objects in the collection. Each item includes a type field.

per_page.description: Number of results returned per page.
